**Comments:**
The DCP was reviewed in our screening room on 12/09. Reels 1–5 played without issue. The gamma lift that was flagged in the earlier QC report (reel 1) has been corrected in this master. The new version matches the reference monitor within acceptable tolerance. No further picture issues noted.

Audio levels were consistent across all reels. The 5.1 mix was verified against the reference stems provided by the sound house. No clipping or dropouts detected. The DCP's MXF files were validated against the manifest; all checksums matched.

Both LTO tapes were received on 12/16. The tapes were labeled correctly with the project name, date, and reel count. The file structure on the tapes was verified by our archive coordinator (J. Park) on 12/17. The directory tree matches the agreed-upon spec. The checksums for the master files were verified on tape #1; tape #2 was spot-checked and matched.

**Original due date:** 12/13/2024 (Friday)

**Actual completion date:** 12/16/2024 (Monday)

**Vendor's stated reason for delay:** The LTO-9 tape stock was backordered from their usual supplier. They received the stock on Friday 12/13 but did not have enough time to complete the write and verification process before the end of their business day. They wrote the tapes on Saturday 12/14 and verified them on Monday 12/16 before shipping.
